title: Buddhagupta stone inscribed
description: A sea captain's Sanskrit inscription from this time is among the earliest written records of the Indian trade with the Malay Peninsula.

title: Terengganu Inscription Stone
description: A stone setting out Islamic law in Malay written in Arabic script is the oldest evidence of Islam as a state religion on the peninsula.

title: Malacca founded
description: Parameswara, a prince who had fled Singapura, founds a port that becomes the main trading centre of Southeast Asia.

title: Parameswara visits the Ming court
description: The ruler of Malacca travels to China with Zheng He's fleet and secures the emperor's protection against Siam.

title: Johor Sultanate founded
description: A son of the last sultan of Malacca sets up a new court on the Johor River, continuing the Malacca line.

title: Dutch take Malacca
description: After a siege of five months the Dutch East India Company and its ally Johor capture the city from the Portuguese.

title: Sultan Mahmud II killed
description: The murder of the childless sultan ends the royal line descended from Malacca and opens a century of rivalry between Malay and Bugis factions.

title: British settle Penang
description: Francis Light takes possession of the island for the East India Company, the first British settlement on the Malay Peninsula.

title: Anglo-Dutch Treaty
description: Britain and the Netherlands divide the Malay world, with Malacca and the peninsula going to Britain and Sumatra and the islands to the south to the Dutch.

title: Straits Settlements formed
description: The East India Company joins Penang, Malacca and Singapore in a single administration.

title: James Brooke becomes Rajah of Sarawak
description: The Sultan of Brunei's governor makes an English adventurer ruler of Sarawak, founding a dynasty that lasts until 1946.

title: Kuala Lumpur founded
description: Chinese miners sent to open tin mines settle where the Gombak and Klang rivers meet.

title: Pangkor Treaty
description: The Sultan of Perak accepts a British Resident whose advice must be followed, the model for British control of the Malay states.

title: North Borneo Company chartered
description: A British chartered company is given the right to govern the territory that is now Sabah.

title: Federated Malay States formed
description: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang are joined in a federation with its capital at Kuala Lumpur.

title: Japanese landing at Kota Bharu
description: Japanese troops land on the north-east coast shortly before the attack on Pearl Harbor and overrun Malaya in ten weeks.

title: Malayan Union created
description: Britain merges the Malay states under a governor, and Malay opposition to the loss of the sultans' powers leads to the founding of the party UMNO.

title: Federation of Malaya formed
description: The Malayan Union is replaced by a federation that restores the position of the Malay rulers.

title: Malayan Emergency declared
description: After communist guerrillas kill three European planters, Britain declares a state of emergency that lasts twelve years.

title: Independence of Malaya
description: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaims independence from Britain at the Merdeka Stadium.

title: Confrontation with Indonesia begins
description: A raid across the border on a police station opens three years of undeclared war in which Indonesia tries to prevent the creation of Malaysia.

title: Malaysia formed
description: Malaya, Singapore, Sarawak and North Borneo join in a new federation.

title: 13 May riots
description: Fighting between Malays and Chinese after a general election kills hundreds and leads to emergency rule and policies favouring Malays.

title: Mahathir becomes prime minister
description: Mahathir Mohamad begins twenty-two years in office, during which Malaysia industrialises rapidly.

title: Anwar Ibrahim dismissed
description: During the Asian financial crisis Mahathir sacks his deputy, whose arrest sets off the Reformasi protest movement.

title: Petronas Towers opened
description: The twin towers, then the tallest buildings in the world, are officially opened.

title: Flight MH370 disappears
description: A Malaysia Airlines aircraft bound for Beijing with 239 people on board vanishes after take-off and is never found.

title: First change of government
description: The coalition that had governed since independence loses a general election for the first time, and Mahathir returns as prime minister.
